verification.reason: Source SQL/contracts changed for grouped filters, numeric normalization, exact native record lookup and audited PostgreSQL browser copying

corrective_findings: Physical fixture originally forced one connection; explicit eight-connection fixture now proves actual overlapping starts and lock-wait revocation rather than serialized goroutines
Aggregate group validation and evidence tracing now distinguish SQL predicates from ordinary boolean payload expressions
PostgreSQL numeric aggregate results normalize finite scalars; MySQL AVG casts to DOUBLE and preserves float64 rather than a decimal string, avoiding changed exact comparisons
Native published record reads explicitly use the real owner's v005 exact-key lookup contract; its actual upgrade plan and definer grants run in the disposable fixture
PostgreSQL scenario copy now remaps rule-hit references to copied rules and rejects missing mappings atomically
limitations: PostgreSQL remains the configured shared application database. No application database was reset; no deployment or MySQL activation occurred.

Physical worker tests use explicit fixture service authority; deployment worker supervision and identity remain configuration/release work. Metadata restricted roles are verified separately from physical installer authority.
PostgreSQL aggregate physical tables mirror the published logical model; this is not a PostgreSQL data-model DDL upgrade rehearsal.
PostgreSQL browser copy is implemented as an owner API; existing deployment HTTP routing is unchanged.
Screening publication mutations cover the projection contract, not the full comments/whitelist/case-event or external-provider lifecycle.

External receipt providers, complete effect journeys, all-path restricted accounts, crash/uncertain-commit acceptance, agreed load targets and sustained shared workload, migration/release/fencing and runtime activation remain open.
Connection arithmetic is a capacity plan, not a measured throughput or production topology certification.
